description:
[0.98a] Per Class Limits
Version: v1.0.1

A lightweight campaign mod that applies soft caps to the player’s warship lineup by hull size.
You can exceed the caps, but doing so applies escalating penalties.
This mod makes the game strictly harder.
I had the idea of making this mod for few last playthroughs, and also found pretty much the same idea here (make fleets great again!)

Features

Soft limits per hull size (default: 1 capital, 3 cruisers, 6 destroyers, unlimited frigates).
Max CR penalties scale based on how far you exceed a class cap.
Fleetwide operating pressure: increased supplies/month and fuel use when over caps.
Clear UI indicator: affected ships receive a warning hullmod (“Over Command Limit”) showing the active penalty details.
Configurable via lunalib (caps and scaling).

Screenshots

Spoiler

Download!

Downloads List

PerClassLimits.zip (GitHub Release): https://github.com/Fiard/SS-Per-Class-Limits/releases/download/v1.0.1/PerClassLimits.zip
All releases list (GitHub): https://github.com/Fiard/SS-Per-Class-Limits/releases

Installation

Unzip into: Starsector/mods/
Folder structure should be: Starsector/mods/PerClassLimits/mod_info.json
Enable Per Class Limits in the launcher.

Compatibility

Designed for Starsector 0.98a.
Generally safe to add to an existing save.
Removing mid-save is not recommended.

Configuration
Settings file (if you don't use lunalib):

PerClassLimits/data/config/pcl_settings.json

Notes:

What Counts as a "Warship"? Any ships that are not pure logistic ships (liner/transport/tanker), and specifically combat freighters. Civilian freighters do not count.

Known Issues

None currently known. If you encounter a problem, please attach starsector.log and your mod list.

TODO list

Add lunalib settings
Add version checker support
Add new fleet ability to temporarily (few weeks) increase limits with long cooldown, so that you can prepare and fight star fortresses or some tough events
